title: Anker Soundcore Space 2 Pro Review: Big Bang For Less Bucks - Engadget
summary: The Space 2 Pro is a set of slightly above average headphones with exceptional voice clarity.
text:
The company’s latest headphones rival Apple, Bose and Sony at a much lower price.

If you don't like the idea of paying $350 to $500 for a set of flagship headphones, Anker's Soundcore line offers a lot of performance at much lower prices. Over the years, the company has refined its formula by balancing sound and features in various packages so as to compete with the likes of Apple, Bose, Sony and Sennheiser. With the Space 2 Pro , Anker put its new Thus audio chip in headphones for the first time , making lofty claims about the upgraded voice clarity as a result. At $200, these aren't just an affordable alternative to the big names in headphones, they're a worthy contender in their own right.

Billy Steele for Engadget The first thing that stood out to me about the Space 2 Pro is the design. These do not look like they cost $200, especially not the grey version that I tested. Anker refined the look of the Space line here for a premium aesthetic and a build that's lightweight, but not overly plastic. title: The Enough Phone is made by and for people fed up with big screens - The Verge
text:
Allison Johnson Close Allison Johnson Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Share Gift If you buy something from a link, The Verge may earn a commission. See our ethics statement.

It’s a bad time and maybe also a great time to make a new smartphone.

Brennan Jordan and Austin Boer are two-thirds of the trio behind the Enough Phone , a small phone that will run your choice of stock Android or the minimalist OdysseyOS. They’re currently seeking funding on Kickstarter , and just a day after launching, the project is over halfway to its $250,000 goal.

The Enough Phone’s target specifications include a 5.3-inch display, 3,500mAh user-replaceable battery, MediaTek Dimensity 7500 chipset, a 50-megapixel Sony sensor in the rear camera, and 8GB of RAM. The dimensions listed on the Kickstarter page suggest an iPhone Mini-ish size; Jordan and Boer also happen to be former iPhone Mini users themselves.

The two of them cofounded a software startup called Sleke , which sells refurbished phones loaded with OdysseyOS, their minimalist, low-distraction version of Android. Putting the software on existing phones is a win for sustainability, but it also helps them get their software to market faster, Boer tells me. The pair offers small batches of Pixel 8 and 9 phones right now through the Sleke website, but the large devices didn’t feel quite right to some customers.

summary: You may have seen Akai tease an "open-source" MPC keyboard running vibe-coded mods. But there's more coming—a lot more. inMusic, parent of Moog, Akai, Numark, Alesis, Denon, and others, promises that many of its 22 product launches coming in January will be open to modders and developer. That suggests a sweeping change in approach for the music gear giant. inMusic CEO Jack O'Donnell shared a glimpse of their emerging vision on modding with CDM.
text:
You may have seen Akai tease an “open-source” MPC keyboard running vibe-coded mods. But there’s more coming—a lot more. inMusic, parent of Moog, Akai, Numark, Alesis, Denon, and others, promises that many of its 22 product launches coming in January will be open to modders and developer. That suggests a sweeping change in approach for the music gear giant. inMusic CEO Jack O’Donnell shared a glimpse of their emerging vision on modding with CDM.

It sounds like inMusic will lean into what’s happening in the modding community. The first indication of that was a teaser of vibe coding on the upcoming MPC Sample Keys.

View this post on Instagram inMusic told Terrence O’Brien at The Verge last week that they will release versions of both MPC Sample and MPC Sample Keys that are open to custom coding, and intend to seed hardware to that coder community.

Note that this does not necessarily mean open-source hardware or even open-source firmware. On some devices, we will see something more akin to what Ableton did with Extensions, where custom code (including AI-assisted code) runs in a separate environment. I’ll talk about that more when the next MPC SDK becomes available. And I do expect the next word you’ll see a lot industry-wide is “sandboxing.” Protecting the environment where a coder works has multiple benefits, not least being you protect your experiments from interfering with the operation of your gear.

Apple's new high-end ‌MacBook Pro‌ models come with M5 Pro or M5 Max, and the major change is the display. It's touch-enabled and is the first Mac with an ‌OLED‌ display. Apple also brought back the glowing Apple logo, and replaced the notch with a Dynamic Island . Pricing on the PROLED ‌MacBook Pro‌ starts at $2,899 for the 14-inch model and $3,399 for the 16-inch model.

The ‌OLED‌ ‌iPad mini‌ is Apple's first smaller-screened iPad to get ‌OLED‌, and it's also the most affordable ‌OLED‌ ‌iPad‌. It's almost a millimeter thinner than the prior version and has an Acoustic Display that does away with speaker holes. Without them, the enclosure is sealed, making it the first ‌iPad‌ with a water and dust resistance rating (IP67). It uses Apple's A20 Pro chip. The ‌OLED‌ ‌iPad mini‌ starts at $699.

The 14-inch entry-level ‌MacBook Pro‌ and 24-inch ‌iMac‌ got little in the way of updates beyond an M6 chip. The ‌MacBook Pro‌ is priced starting at $1,999, and the ‌iMac‌ starts at $1,499.

title: OpenAI's new cyber model found ways to attack nearly 1000 Linux flaws - Axios
summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber will initially be available to a small number of approved customers due to concerns that, in the wrong hands, it could supercharge cyberattacks.
text:
OpenAI has debuted a new AI model geared towards helping cybersecurity professionals. The company says that the new model, called GPT-6 Cyber, outperforms its general-purpose GPT-6 Astra model on most cyber tasks. Because of the risk that the model could be used to conduct cyberattacks if it fell into the wrong hands, OpenAI is current making the model available only to a small handful approved security customers. Fortune first reported that OpenAI was planning to release a specialized cyber model based on GPT-6 in September.

As AI models have become better at finding software flaws and turning them into working attacks, businesses have come under increasing pressure to strengthen their cyber defenses. Gartner forecast in September that worldwide AI cybersecurity spending would reach $51.3 billion this year, nearly double last year’s $25.9 billion. OpenAI is increasingly leaning into this market, seeing it as an important path to growing its enterprise sales. This is OpenAI’s fourth cybersecurity-focused model this year, following versions released in April, June and August. The company also hired a chief revenue officer, Dali Rajic , who comes from a cybersecurity software background.

title: Rockstar shares 38 new screenshots of Grand Theft Auto 6, showing off Vice City, Jason and Lucia, and much more - Eurogamer.net
summary: Rockstar Games have released an album of new in-game Grand Theft Auto 6, which offer perhaps our final peak at the game before its launch later this month.
text:
Image credit: Eurogamer News by Connor Makar Reporter Published on Nov. 5, 2026, 4:18 p.m. 52 comments Follow Grand Theft Auto VI Prioritise us on Google Rockstar Games have released 38 new screenshots of Grand Theft Auto 6 , ahead of its release later this month.

These screenshots, found on a dedicated launch gallery website Rockstar has created , prompts viewers to scroll down and take in the sights of several high quality in-game screenshots snapshotting all kinds of people, places, and events.

These include, but are not limited to, a DJ set in-action, a man and his pitbull looking tough to the camera, a tattooed man getting his hair done (machine gun on hand), and a daring motorbike escape. However, my personal favourite has got to be a lively shot of a dive bar. A band - seemingly called The Rusty Anchor is playing - and some older ladies appear to be having a friendly chat with an open-shirt-wearing geezer enjoying a beer.

You can find all the new images in an image gallery below. So look through them at your pleasure:

Grand Theft Auto 6 is due to release on the 19th November on PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. A few days prior, Rockstar employees are voting on whether or not they'd like to officially recognise a developer union , as the Rockstar vs IWBG union employment tribunal comes to a close on the eve of GTA 6's release date.
